description: Creates a Mizan API key for an agent_id via POST /v1/keys and returns it once (the server does not keep a copy). Default scope is read; scope "write" is required for mizan_check. Passing an existing read key with scope "write" upgrades it once. agent_id is first-come and is not a verified identity.

api_key.description: Optional. Pass your current read-only key (with scope: "write") to perform a one-time upgrade of that key for the same agent_id.

label.description: Optional short label for this key.

scope.description: Optional. "read" (default) can read passports; "write" is required to submit with mizan_check or request a certificate. Write keys also have a per-key write limit (30 per hour).

name: mizan_issue_key
title: Issue Mizan API key
